members: public ValidationService(TelemetryProperties properties, StepLog stepLog, MeterRegistry meterRegistry) { this.properties = properties; this.stepLog = stepLog; this.meterRegistry = meterRegistry; }

private boolean isValid(String metric, double value) { if (metric == null) { return true; } return switch (metric) { case "heart_rate" -> value >= properties.heartRateMin() && value <= properties.heartRateMax(); case "power" -> value >= properties.powerMin() && value <= properties.powerMax(); case "cadence" -> value >= properties.cadenceMin() && value <= properties.cadenceMax(); case "swim_pace" -> value > properties.swimPaceMinExclusive(); default -> true; }; }
